findings.evidence: Lines 68-74: Form with digest frequency select and Save button. No next screen or feedback state defined after Save.
findings.fix: Specify what feedback the user sees after clicking Save: a success confirmation message on the same screen or navigation to a next screen.

findings.evidence: Lines 50-59: Archive confirmation flow leads to project-archived state confirming removal from active list, but no unarchive path exists in the artifact.
findings.fix: Define an unarchive control or show a separate 'Archived projects' screen with the ability to restore an archived project.
